statement: Share of firms using AI to produce goods or services >= 2x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census Bureau BTOS, 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2024 (baseline is the 2025 average). The Bloc A business survey's biweekly AI-use share rose from 3.7% (Sept 2023, first collection) to 5.4% (Feb 2024), ~5.9% (Sept 2024) and ~6.1% (Nov-Dec 2024) - steady but slow growth, slightly below firms' own Feb-2024 expectation of 6.6% by fall. Employment-weighted use was higher (~9% current, ~12% expected). Few firms reported AI-driven headcount changes.

items.summary: Statistics-office working paper on the new business-survey AI questions: biweekly AI-use share rose from 3.7% (Sept 2023) to 5.4% (Feb 2024), +46% in five months; firms expected ~6.6% by fall 2024. Employment-weighted use averaged ~9.4% (excluding don't-know). Use ranged from 1.4% in construction/agriculture to 18.1% in information.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau CES-WP-24-16 (Bonney et al., 'Tracking Firm Use of AI in Real Time', March 2024; day approximate; also NBER w32319). Verified via search snippet of the Census PDF.

items.summary: Same survey: 2.8% of firms reported AI raised employment and 2.6% that it lowered employment over the prior six months; 94.6% reported no change.
items.detail: CES-WP-24-16, Table 'Effects of AI on Firm Employment', firm-weighted (Bloc A).
items.value: 2.6 % of firms report AI-driven employment decrease

items.summary: Business-survey biweekly AI-use share ~5.9% for the period ending early September 2024.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS AI core question, cycle ending 2024-09-08, value 5.9% via usstats.io aggregator of the Census AI file (verified). Publication day approximate (BTOS posts ~10 days after period end).

items.summary: Business-survey biweekly AI-use share 6.0-6.1% across Oct-Dec 2024 cycles (6.1% for the period ending 1 Dec 2024): growth flattening in Q4 2024.
items.detail: Bloc A Census BTOS biweekly estimates via usstats.io (verified): 2024-10-20 6.0%, 11-03 6.1%, 11-17 6.1%, 12-01 6.1%. Later cycles (published after 2024-12-31) excluded. Publication day approximate.
